gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, as of 2026-11-13, Mobile Pixels' own store sells the Duex Float 2 Pro for $309.99, not the $263.49 shown on the cited Mobile Pixels Black Friday page, or that Xebec's US store search does not list the Snap Stack-Up Mount on its own: the only Xebec setup that mounts above the screen comes in the $884 Snap Stack Bundle, not the ~$708 ($609 + $99) ChatGPT quoted.
standout_why: I compared against the Mobile Pixels Black Friday blog (cited), the Macworld Duex Float 2 Pro review (cited), the Fstoppers photographers' guide (cited) and our own page. The MP blog gives $263.49 as the current sale price. Macworld lists older retailer prices (Lenovo $239.99, B&H $249.99, Mobile Pixels $299.99). Fstoppers gives no price for the Float 2 Pro. None of them prices the Xebec route. Our page and ChatGPT say $609 + $99 mount, but I could not find the mount for sale on its own in the US store today. None of these pages gives today's maker-store price for both products in one comparison.
decides: This confirms the Duex Float 2 Pro as the pick and makes the case against Xebec stronger. At today's maker-store prices, the Float 2 Pro ($309.99) costs about a third of the cheapest Xebec setup that mounts above the screen and that I could price ($884 Snap Stack Bundle). The page should also tell readers that the $263.49 Mobile Pixels price ChatGPT repeats is not the price on Mobile Pixels' store today.
